grammar_title: 不定式作定语和结果状语(to do)
source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第二册 Unit 3 Using language:to-infinitive as attributive and adverbial of result。句子地道、运动主题、答案唯一(干扰项为 -ing/-ed/限定式,使不定式唯一成立)。

points.point: 不定式作定语(名词 + to do:something to eat / the first to do)
points.overview: 在名词或不定代词后用 to do 作后置定语,表示「该名词要做的/可做的事」;序数词、the only/last/next 后的名词也常接 to do。-ing/-ed/限定式都不能这样作定语。

points.point: 不定式作结果状语(too…to / enough to / so…as to)
points.overview: too + 形/副 + to do 表「太……以致不能」;形/副 + enough + to do 表「足够……可以」;so + 形/副 + as to do 表「如此……以致」。这些结构后只能跟 to do 表结果。

points.point: 不定式作目的状语与结果状语的对比(to do)
points.overview: to do 既可表目的(= in order to,「为了」),也可表结果(too…to / enough to / so…as to)。无论目的还是结果,空处都用 to do;-ing/-ed/限定式不能充当这一状语。

questions.stem: Football is a simple game ____, which is one reason for its huge popularity.
questions.explanation: 名词 game 后用 to do 作定语,表示「可以玩的游戏」;-ing/-ed/限定式都不能这样作后置定语。

questions.stem: He was the first player ____ the winning goal in the final match.
questions.explanation: 序数词 the first 后的名词接 to do 作定语,意为「第一个进球的球员」。

questions.stem: After the long match, we looked for something cold ____.
questions.explanation: 不定代词 something 后用 to do 作定语,表示「可以喝的东西」。

questions.stem: She is always the last one ____ the training ground every evening.
questions.explanation: the last one 后接 to do 作定语,意为「最后一个离开的人」。

questions.stem: I still have a lot of training ____ before the championship begins.
questions.explanation: 名词 training 后用 to do 作定语,表示「要做的训练」。

questions.stem: This app gives runners a good way ____ their daily progress.
questions.explanation: way 后用 to do 作定语,表示「记录进展的方法」。

questions.stem: A skipping rope is a cheap piece of equipment ____ almost anywhere.
questions.explanation: 名词 equipment 后用 to do 作定语,表示「可以使用的器材」。

questions.stem: The coach gave us several new exercises ____ at home this week.
questions.explanation: 名词 exercises 后用 to do 作定语,意为「可以尝试的练习」。

questions.stem: Tai chi is a wonderful art ____ if you want to relax your mind.
questions.explanation: 名词 art 后用 to do 作定语,表示「值得学的一门艺术」。

questions.stem: He was the only member of the team ____ for the gorilla run.
questions.explanation: the only member 后用 to do 作定语,意为「唯一报名的人」。

questions.stem: There is no time ____; the marathon starts in ten minutes.
questions.explanation: 名词 time 后用 to do 作定语,no time to lose 意为「没有时间可浪费」。

questions.stem: She bought a watch with a clear display ____ her heart rate.
questions.explanation: 名词 display 后用 to do 作定语,表示「用来监测心率的显示屏」。

questions.stem: Pull-ups are a great way ____ strength in your upper body.
questions.explanation: way 后用 to do 作定语,表示「增强力量的方法」。

questions.stem: The teacher was looking for a sport ____ to the whole PE class.
questions.explanation: 名词 sport 后用 to do 作定语,意为「可以推荐的运动」。

questions.stem: Running gave him a real reason ____ out of bed early every day.
questions.explanation: 名词 reason 后用 to do 作定语,表示「早起的理由」。

questions.stem: The club has plenty of ropes and bars ____ during training.
questions.explanation: 名词 ropes and bars 后用 to do 作定语,意为「训练时可用的器材」。

questions.stem: He is exactly the kind of champion ____ — humble and hard-working.
questions.explanation: 名词 champion 后用 to do 作定语,表示「值得敬佩的冠军」。

questions.stem: We need a quiet place ____ before the big game tonight.
questions.explanation: 名词 place 后用 to do 作定语,意为「可以休息的地方」。

questions.stem: The plank is a simple exercise ____ almost anywhere, even at home.
questions.explanation: 名词 exercise 后用 to do 作定语,表示「可以做的练习」。

questions.stem: She was the second runner ____ the finish line in the school race.
questions.explanation: 序数词 the second 后的名词接 to do 作定语,意为「第二个冲线的人」。

questions.stem: He was too tired ____, so he had to stop running.
questions.explanation: too + 形 + to do 表「太累以致不能继续」,空处只能用 to do。

questions.stem: The ball is small enough ____ into most sports bags.
questions.explanation: 形 + enough + to do 表「足够小可以放进去」,空处用 to do 表结果。

questions.stem: Football is fun enough ____ millions of people around the world.
questions.explanation: 形 + enough + to do 表「有趣到足以吸引……」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: After the marathon, she was too exhausted even ____.
questions.explanation: too + 形 + to do 表「太累以致连走都走不动」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: The young player trained hard enough ____ a place on the top team.
questions.explanation: 副 + enough + to do 表「足够努力以致赢得席位」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: The watch band is adjustable enough ____ almost any wrist.
questions.explanation: 形 + enough + to do 表「足够可调以致适合……」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: He ran so fast as ____ all the other runners far behind.
questions.explanation: so + 副 + as to do 表「如此快以致把别人甩在后面」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: The plank looks easy, but it is hard enough ____ your core muscles.
questions.explanation: 形 + enough + to do 表「足够吃力以致能锻炼……」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: She was strong enough ____ her whole body on the bar for a minute.
questions.explanation: 形 + enough + to do 表「足够强壮以致能支撑身体」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: The match was so exciting as ____ everyone on the edge of their seats.
questions.explanation: so + 形 + as to do 表「如此精彩以致让所有人紧张」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: It was too cold ____ outside, so we trained in the gym instead.
questions.explanation: too + 形 + to do 表「太冷以致不能在外训练」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: At sixteen he was old enough ____ in the under-18 race.
questions.explanation: 形 + enough + to do 表「足够大可以参赛」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: The gorilla suit was too hot ____ comfortably during the long run.
questions.explanation: too + 形 + to do 表「太热以致穿着不舒服」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: Her lungs grew strong enough ____ in national competitions.
questions.explanation: 形 + enough + to do 表「足够强健以致能参赛跑步」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: The rules are simple enough for a child ____ in a few minutes.
questions.explanation: enough + for sb + to do 表「简单到孩子也能学会」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: He was too nervous before the final ____ anything at all.
questions.explanation: too + 形 + to do 表「太紧张以致什么也吃不下」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: The skipping rope is light enough ____ in any small pocket.
questions.explanation: 形 + enough + to do 表「足够轻以致能装进口袋」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: The team played so well as ____ the championship that very year.
questions.explanation: so + 副 + as to do 表「踢得如此好以致赢得冠军」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: My legs ached too much ____ another lap of the track.
questions.explanation: too + 副 + to do 表「太痛以致再也跑不动一圈」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: Tai chi is gentle enough for older people ____ every morning.
questions.explanation: 形 + enough + for sb + to do 表「温和到老人也能每天练」,空处用 to do。

questions.stem: Every morning she goes to the park ____ tai chi with a master.
questions.explanation: to do 在此表目的(为了练太极而去公园);限定式/分词不能作目的状语。

questions.stem: He downloaded a fitness app ____ his progress against his friends.
questions.explanation: to do 表目的(下载应用是为了记录进展),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: The watch is light enough ____ all day without any trouble.
questions.explanation: enough + to do 表结果(轻到可以戴一整天),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: She joined an athletics club ____ her weak lungs stronger.
questions.explanation: to do 表目的(加入俱乐部是为了让肺更强健),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: He gets up at five ____ for two hours before going to work.
questions.explanation: to do 表目的(早起是为了训练),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: The game is simple enough ____ anywhere with just a cheap ball.
questions.explanation: enough + to do 表结果(简单到随处可玩),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: Many people travel to Yangshuo ____ tai chi from a great master.
questions.explanation: to do 表目的(去阳朔是为了学太极),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: On that day the soldiers put down their guns ____ football together.
questions.explanation: to do 表目的(放下枪是为了一起踢球),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: He was too stressed after work ____ well at night.
questions.explanation: too + 形 + to do 表结果(太焦虑以致睡不好),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: She wears a smart watch ____ her heart rate during exercise.
questions.explanation: to do 表目的(戴手表是为了监测心率),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: These exercises are gentle enough ____ at home without a coach.
questions.explanation: enough + to do 表结果(温和到可以在家做),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: He runs every evening ____ the stress of a busy working day.
questions.explanation: to do 表目的(跑步是为了摆脱压力),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: The race was so tiring as ____ his legs aching for several days.
questions.explanation: so + 形 + as to do 表结果(累到让腿痛了好几天),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: She practised hard every single day ____ the school champion.
questions.explanation: to do 表目的(刻苦练习是为了成为校冠军),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: The running app was fun enough ____ him going for many months.
questions.explanation: enough + to do 表结果(有趣到让他坚持了好几个月),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: He wore a gorilla suit ____ money for the world's last gorillas.
questions.explanation: to do 表目的(穿大猩猩服是为了筹款),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: Tai chi is slow enough for anyone ____ , whatever their age.
questions.explanation: enough + for sb + to do 表结果(慢到任何人都能享受),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: We use bar charts ____ how something changes over time.
questions.explanation: to do 表目的(用条形图是为了展示变化),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: He trained hard enough ____ a place in the national team.
questions.explanation: enough + to do 表结果(足够努力以致赢得国家队席位),空处用不定式。

questions.stem: She started running ____ her doctor's advice about her asthma.
questions.explanation: to do 表目的(开始跑步是为了听从医生的建议),空处用不定式。
